decision_rule: Synthetic, GPU-independent Q4_K MUL_MAT_ID diagnostic scoped to M2048 only. Smoke must produce the actual 4-thread native graph timing and byte-exact batched/serial PASS with n_reps>=2; full run requires 54 finite positive timing records plus associated PASS/aa_clean correctness: every M2048 mode (rand/shared/disjoint), k=1..9, at both physical 48- and 96-thread arms. Lower graph latency is better; higher effective logical GB/s is better, where logical bytes are selected-weight rows plus activation, IDs, and output bytes divided by graph_compute time. This is not measured DRAM traffic, a model/serving result, or a winner; no roofline or DRAM-bandwidth conclusion is allowed. Seven alternating pairs are repeated samples in one process, not independent processes and do not establish a noise floor or population confidence interval. Record CPU affinity, FILLER grant/quiet-lock status and overlapping process samples; if not observed, placement/contention are unknown. Bind source, binary, input manifest, actual loaded ggml DSO paths and hashes; label historical DSO source/build provenance unproven, and capture GGML_IQK plus actual runtime IQK capability line. Stop/deadline is checked during and between native arms; no result unit is accepted without correctness PASS. The prior unapproved direct-run output is excluded. A pass contributes only a synthetic profiler diagnostic to AKX-AUTO-10 and closes no handoff by itself.
notes: Inputs are prepared once before publication. The 4-thread smoke is publisher-owned; full 48/96-thread arms require grant through filler_run15. Only M2048 is provisioned to keep this bounded; F2560/F640 are explicitly out of scope. No compiler/native benchmark was run while preparing this row.
